selection_policy.hard_filter: Required features + night front-light requirement; budget is hard only when current numeric VN price is present.
selection_policy.ranking: Primary-use fit + size fit + ecosystem + optional preferences + data confidence
selection_policy.results: 3–5 diverse candidates; near matches only when exact matches do not exist.
selection_policy.commerce: Affiliate presence never changes eligibility or ranking.
selection_policy.budget_gate: Exact matches require observed VN price; min_vnd must be <= selected budget cap. Ranges crossing the cap remain eligible but show a tradeoff.
